t: When a $(l:tools/drone)Drone/$ is deployed, it immediately starts to execute its stored program. Execution flow occurs as follows:$(li)The program $(italic)always/$ begins at the $(l:programming/start)Start/$ widget, of which there can be only one.$(li)Flow normally proceeds $(italic)downward/$; to the widget connected to the bottom of the current widget.
当部署一个$(l:tools/drone)无人机/$时，它会立即开始执行其存储的程序。执行流程如下：$(li)程序$(italic)总是/$从$(l:programming/start)开始/$组件处开始，并且这样的组件只能有一个。$(li)流程通常会$(italic)向下/$进行到与当前组件底部相连的组件。

$(li)A widget executes its given operation until it decides it's $(italic)done/$ - the definition of 'done' varies from widget to widget, and is described in the pages for each individual widget.$(li)When there's no widget connected to the bottom of the current widget, execution returns to the $(l:programming/start)Start/$ widget.$(p)That's the basics. There are few special cases, however, described next...
$(li)程序组件会执行其指定的操作，直到它判定自己已$(italic)完成/$——而“完成”的定义会因程序组件而异，并会在各个程序组件对应的页面中分别说明。$(li)当当前程序组件下方没有连接其他程序组件时，执行流程会返回到$(l:programming/start)开始/$程序组件。$(p)以上就是基础内容。不过，还有少数几种特殊情况，将在下一页说明……

$(li)The $(l:programming/label)Label/$ widget acts a point in the program to be jumped to.$(li)The $(l:programming/jump)Jump/$ widget triggers an immediate, unconditional, jump to a matching $(thing)Label/$ widget.$(li)$(l:programming/conditions)Condition/$ widgets can trigger a jump, based on the condition they're testing.$(li)The advanced $(l:programming/for_each_item)For Each Item/$ and $(l:programming/for_each_coordinate)For Each Coordinate/$ widgets repeatedly jump to a $(thing)Label/$, for their list of inputs.

$(li)$(l:programming/label)标签/$组件的作用是作为程序中可跳转到的目标点。$(li)$(l:programming/jump)跳跃/$组件会立即无条件地跳转到与之匹配的$(thing)标签/$组件。$(li)$(l:programming/conditions)条件/$组件也可以根据其所测试的条件来触发跳转。$(li)高级的$(l:programming/for_each_item)对于每个物品/$和$(l:programming/for_each_coordinate)对于每个坐标/$组件会针对其输入列表反复跳转到某个$(thing)标签/$。

A couple more special widgets exist, which affect flow control:$(li)The $(l:programming/standby)Standby/$ widget, which puts the drone to 'sleep' until another widget actually has something to do.$(li)The $(l:programming/suicide)Suicide/$ widget, which drops the $(thing)Drone/$ as an item, immediately terminating execution.
还有几种特殊组件会影响流程控制：$(li)$(l:programming/standby)待机/$组件会让无人机“休眠”，直到另一个组件确实有事情可做。$(li)$(l:programming/suicide)自毁/$组件会将$(thing)无人机/$掉落为物品，并立即终止执行。
